command:
python3 - <<'PY'
path='mux_test.go'
s=open(path).read()
old='''	after := DefaultSnmp.Copy()
	if after.MuxStreamsOpened <= before.MuxStreamsOpened {'''
new='''	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	after := DefaultSnmp.Copy()
	t.Logf("before: sent=%d recv=%d framesSent=%d framesRecv=%d opened=%d", before.MuxBytesSent, before.MuxBytesReceived, before.MuxFramesSent, before.MuxFramesReceived, before.MuxStreamsOpened)
	t.Logf("after:  sent=%d recv=%d framesSent=%d framesRecv=%d opened=%d", after.MuxBytesSent, after.MuxBytesReceived, after.MuxFramesSent, after.MuxFramesReceived, after.MuxStreamsOpened)
	if after.MuxStreamsOpened <= before.MuxStreamsOpened {'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(path,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w mux_test.go && timeout 25 go test -run 'TestMuxPriorityScheduling|TestMuxSNMP' -count=1 -v -timeout 20s . 2>&1; echo "EXIT: $?"
